findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. If another merge moves main, `merge.merge` can call `close.close` again (`src/forge/merge.py:113-122`). A blocked review, failed test, or failed check from that call reaches this handler and retains close's `forge work <item>` next step. A failed check at merge's own check gate (`src/forge/merge.py:79`) does the same. Item 4 requires these changes to stop with `forge land <item>` as the fix-round step.
findings.title: Not done: merge-time close failures route to fix rounds

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. Readiness uses `board._machine_prs`, which queries only the newest 25 open pull requests (`src/forge/board.py:79`). For an older pull request with a matching clean receipt and a failed check, its PR is absent, so `board._checks` returns `unknown` (`src/forge/board.py:138-140`). `_item_readiness` then treats the receipt as ready (`src/forge/nextstep.py:668-687`). The change bypasses the required hold behind an older change editing the same file.
findings.title: Not done: failed checks on older pull requests prevent the ready overlap bypass
